stories.headline: Indonesia faces $80 billion stock market rout amid MSCI downgrade warning
stories.summary: Indonesia's stock market suffered one of its worst selloffs since 1998, with $80 billion wiped out over two days. MSCI warned it may downgrade Indonesian equities to 'frontier' status, triggering the resignations of the heads of the financial regulator and stock exchange. Investors are concerned about President Prabowo's fiscal policies and state intervention in markets.

stories.headline: Parliament approves Thomas Djiwandono as Bank Indonesia deputy governor despite independence concerns
stories.summary: Indonesia's parliament appointed President Prabowo's nephew, Thomas Djiwandono, as deputy governor of Bank Indonesia. The nomination has sparked investor concerns about the central bank's independence, contributing to the rupiah hitting record lows. Djiwandono previously served as deputy finance minister and resigned from Gerindra party positions.

stories.headline: Danantara takes over land from 28 companies linked to Sumatra floods
stories.summary: Sovereign wealth fund Danantara Indonesia will take over approximately 1 million hectares of land from 28 companies whose permits were revoked after being linked to environmental violations that contributed to floods and landslides in Sumatra. Danantara created a new subsidiary, Perminas, to manage mining operations including the Martabe gold mine.

stories.headline: Political parties debate placing police under ministry versus direct presidential control
stories.summary: A debate emerged over whether Indonesia's police force (Polri) should be placed under a ministry or remain directly under the President. PDI-P previously proposed ministerial oversight, while Golkar, PKS, and PKB factions support keeping Polri under direct presidential control. The discussion occurred during parliamentary meetings with the national police chief.

stories.headline: Danantara announces major stock market investment strategy amid crisis
stories.summary: Indonesia's sovereign wealth fund Danantara instructed asset managers to continue buying local stocks with strong fundamentals and liquidity during the market crisis. Danantara also revealed plans to potentially own 15-30% of the Indonesian stock exchange after demutualization and disclosed it has already been investing daily in the stock market through various asset managers.

stories.headline: Prabowo joins Board of Peace initiative with Trump and other leaders
stories.summary: President Prabowo Subianto joined the Board of Peace (BoP) charter signing alongside Donald Trump and other leaders. Indonesia's participation is seen as geopolitical tactical awareness that multilateralism is weakening. Prabowo also clarified statements about Israel security guarantees that circulated on social media, explaining Indonesia's balanced position on Middle East peace.

stories.headline: Golkar appoints Sari Yuliati as new deputy parliament speaker
stories.summary: Golkar party appointed Sari Yuliati as deputy speaker of parliament (DPR) to replace Adies Kadir, who resigned after being nominated as Constitutional Court judge. Yuliati previously served as deputy chair of Commission III and treasurer of Golkar party. The appointment was part of Golkar's commitment to inclusivity and women's emancipation.

stories.headline: Prabowo appoints National Energy Council and accelerates housing programs
stories.summary: President Prabowo Subianto inaugurated the National Energy Council membership at the State Palace and met with Housing Minister Maruarar Sirait to discuss accelerating affordable housing programs. The energy council appointment included government officials and stakeholders, while the housing meeting focused on strategic steps to speed up provision of affordable housing for the public.

stories.headline: PDI-P criticizes Jokowi's commitment to PSI and comments on rupiah weakness
stories.summary: PDI-P politician Guntur Romli criticized former President Jokowi for stating he would work 'to the death' for PSI party. Separately, PDI-P Secretary General Hasto Kristiyanto commented on the weakening rupiah against the US dollar, calling for government solidarity to address the economic crisis.

stories.headline: Pertamina reduces fuel prices and ships crude oil from Algeria operations
stories.summary: State energy company Pertamina reduced prices for non-subsidized fuels including Pertamax, Pertamax Turbo, Pertamax Green, Dexlite, and Pertamina Dex effective February 1. Separately, Pertamina announced the successful arrival of 1 million barrels of crude oil from its Algeria operations at Oil and Gas Block 405A, marking a milestone for the company's international operations.
